cadence: safety-handrails classifies only when frame_number % 8 == 0 and holds the label (main.py:283-285); handrails classifies every frame with a stopped active BL (main.py:1065)
negative top: handrails clamps, safety-handrails slices with a negative start
model_identity.sharing: EXACT as a memoised call keyed by (frame_id, crop box): identical inputs give identical outputs; on frames % 8 == 0 with the same BL and a non-negative top, safety-handrails' call is a duplicate of handrails' call
